Questions, answered

FAQ [ + ]
Is the sauna wood-fired?[ + ]

Yes. It is a wood-fired barrel sauna with a round glass front that faces the fjord.

Where are the sauna and plunge tub?[ + ]

In the garden, a short walk from the house. The wooden cold-plunge tub and outdoor shower are beside it.

How many guests can stay?[ + ]

There are two bedrooms. Tell us your group size in the enquiry and we will confirm.

How do I book?[ + ]

Send the enquiry form with your dates and guests. We reply personally.

Be the first to know when new dates open

A short note a few times a year. New seasons, open dates and news from the house.
